note: Adapted from the original English description of Hill (1922); the original treats the soldier, the worker and the alate (the alate account is not used here); the measurements are printed with a hyphen for the decimal point (e.g. 3-290 is 3.290 mm) and have been written here in mm; the table prints the values for daliensis and perniger side by side on the same line, and they have been separated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head very dark, nearly black; the front of the head, the clypeus, the front of the prothorax and the mandibles slightly paler, the clypeus yellow; antennae, maxillary palps and legs ochreous yellowish brown. Head very large, widest behind, narrowing slightly forwards to the base of the mandibles; frons flat, slightly wrinkled, coronal suture indistinct. Mandibles very long and slender, sickle-shaped, each with a large horn-like tooth near the base and far from the apex, directed slightly forwards. Labrum large, convex, the sides rounded and the apex bluntly rounded. Clypeus large, slightly convex, its anterior margin notched and divided into two halves by a deep median notch. Fontanelle very indistinct. Antennae very long and slender, 19 or 20-segmented, rarely 18; segment 1 about twice as long as segment 2 and about half as wide; segment 2 nearly cylindrical, about one third longer than segment 3; segment 3 narrowest at the base and wider at the apex than segment 4; segment 4 shortest; segment 5 slightly longer and wider than segment 4; segment 6 about as long as segment 2; segment 7 longer and narrower than segment 6. Pronotum similar to that of the preceding species but narrower in the anterior half. Legs long and slender, the inner side of the tibiae with rather long and thick marginal hairs; the upper side of the apex of the mid tibia with 2 short stout setae, absent on the hind tibia; the first 3 tarsal segments very short and the 4th very long; tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Measurements: head with mandibles 3.290—3.807 mm; mandible length 1.551 mm; head depth 1.475 mm; head width 1.645 mm; antenna length 3.666 mm; pronotum length 0.658 mm, width 1.128 mm; length of the fore, mid and hind tibiae 1.410, 1.457, 2.115 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier with the head nearly black and the mandibles very long and curved, antennae 19—20-segmented; compared with D. perniger the head is deeper (1.475 mm versus 1.034 mm) and the mandibles slightly shorter (1.551 mm versus 1.598 mm), and it can be separated by the narrower anterior half of the pronotum and the dark colour of the face.
